label: SBA-first Mythic+ (Diabolist)
notes: Actions: full = purchased at max rank, granted = free rank, partial = ranks bought, choice = API-order option index (verified against in-game-confirmed strings). Absent nodes are unselected.

99848 is this spec's subtree (hero) selector: choice index 0 = Diabolist, 1 = Hellcaller (matches verified Destruction strings). It costs 1 class point, which is why Banish was dropped to hold the class budget at 34.
99849/99850 are the other specs' selectors (unselected here). They are absent from the web API but present in client data and all verified strings.

Choice sides taken: Horrify, Frequent Donor, Howl of Terror, Dark Accord, Crashing Chaos, Summoner's Embrace, Mayhem, Reverse Entropy, Rain of Fire (@target), Blight of Tongues, Dimensional Rift, Annihilan's Bellow, Infernal Machine, Infernal Bulwark.
Embers of Nihilam is full (all 4 Apex ranks); Devastation is a lone partial at rank 1 of 2.
